reviewer: Computational AI annotator; not human or specialist review.
scope: Only frozen C2-R7 in the five previously declared Camera 2 evaluation frames. The other five references are not re-annotated or newly validated here.
independence_limits: Prior case knowledge, earlier viewing of these frames and v1 results are acknowledged. This is not a pristine holdout or independent human annotation. Root disclosed baseline preflight acceptance; no new later-frame automatic results or analytical match overlays were viewed before these annotations were saved.
coordinate_convention: Zero-based native stored pixel centers; origin upper-left; x right, y down.
uncertainty_definition: Subjective rectangular localization envelope in native encoded pixels, not a calibrated error bound or statistical confidence interval.
anchor_definition: Approximate visual center of the named bright roof-edge patch/cap, not a maximum-intensity pixel, thresholded centroid, surveyed corner or certified material point. Each frame was visually localized separately.
description: Small bright roughly rectangular roof-edge patch/cap on the lower central foreground building, immediately left of the taller gridded foreground block.
role_limit: Apparent neighboring-building patch; exact building/component, material-point identity and depth remain unauthenticated. Highlight/illumination changes, blur/compression, repeated roof texture and overlapping depth planes can alter its appearance or matching. Visual identifiability is not proof of physical stationarity.

annotations.note: Distinct bright compact right-hand patch remains visible beside the dimmer horizontal roof-edge strip and left of the gridded facade; rounded/blurred edges limit the center.
Bright compact patch and its darker right-hand separation from the adjacent facade remain recognizable; the softened lower edge does not supply an exact mathematical center.
The same appearance-defined bright right-hand patch is distinguishable from the dimmer horizontal region to its left; local blur and brightness spread retain several-pixel center uncertainty.
The small bright patch remains visible with the same neighboring roof/facade context; its rounded intensity boundary rather than a hard corner controls subjective localization.

Bright patch is still distinguishable, but the visible brightness profile is softer and the lower edge merges more into the dark foreground region. The nominal one-pixel upward center difference is unresolved within the wider subjective envelope, not a measured displacement.

crop_derivation.display_enlargement: 5x nearest-neighbor only; no contrast adjustment or inferred detail
crop_derivation.labels: External axes every five native source pixels; no candidate or automatic point overlay over image pixels.
crop_derivation.runtime: Python 3.13.7; Pillow 12.0.0, actual generating-command output checked
crop_derivation.limitation: Crops are explicitly labeled analytical localization aids derived from the same source frame, not independent evidence or enhanced resolution.

interpretation_limit: Repeated nominal coordinates followed independent visual inspection, not copying a presumed fixed position. Nominal baseline/evaluation differences and a one-pixel difference between evaluation rows are below the stated subjective resolution; these annotations cannot establish zero/subpixel camera motion, physical stationarity, calibration, target motion, acceleration or cause.
